9Q52: I surrender my soul, my breath of life, and my wealth, to my Lord Master.
My soul life and wealth are accepted as the Lord's own.
DABG: Through His Name, I become radiant; I am known as His slave. ||1||Pause||
I am accounted the maid servant of Him through whose Name I have become pure. Pause.
3ZUZ: You are Carefree, the Embodiment of Bliss. Your Name is a gem, a jewel.
You are care free and embodiment of bliss Your Name is a jewel and a gem.
JH9D: One who has You as her Master, is satisfied, satiated and happy forever. ||2||
Sated satiated and ever happy is she whose Master You are.
SXT3: O my companions and fellow maidens, please implant that balanced understanding within me.
You friends and maids of my association implant to me right understanding.
1L1Y: Serve the Holy Saints lovingly, and find the treasure of the Lord. ||3||
I serve the saints with love therefore obtain God's treasure.
45Y1: All are servants of the Lord Master, and all call Him their own.
All are the hand maidens of the Lord and all call His their own.
EU7Z: She alone dwells in peace, O Nanak, whom the Lord adorns. ||4||15||117||
She alone whom the Lord adorns O Nanak abides in peace.
3FP7: Become the servant of the Saints, and learn this way of life.
Become the handmaiden of the saints and learn you this conduct.
BT48: Of all virtues, the most sublime virtue is to see your Husband Lord near at hand. ||1||
The sublimest virtue of all the virtues is not to see your Spouse afar.
4MGG: So, dye this mind of yours with the color of the Lord's Love.
Dye this beautiful soul of yours with the madder of God's name O bride.
JKAQ: Renounce cleverness and cunning, and know that the Sustainer of the world is with you. ||1||Pause||
Abandon cleverness and cunningness and know you that the World Cherisher is with you. Pause.
Y0C6: Whatever your Husband Lord says, accept that, and make it your decoration.
What the Spouse says act you on that and make this your embellishment.
XZG3: Forget the love of duality, and chew upon this betel leaf. ||2||
Forget the love of another and chew you this betel O bride.
FZ9D: Make the Word of the Guru's Shabad your lamp, and let your bed be Truth.
Make This Gurbani your lamp and spread the couch of chastity.
7BSK: Twenty-four hours a day, stand with your palms pressed together, and the Lord, your King, shall meet you. ||3||
All the day long remain standing with clasped hands than shall the Sovereign Lord meet you O bride.
NYUF: She alone is cultured and embellished, and she alone is of incomparable beauty.
She alone possesses discretion and all the decoration and she is of matchless beauty.
0GWN: She alone is the happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who is pleasing to the Creator Lord. ||4||16||118||
She alone is the true wife O Nanak who is pleasing to the Creator.
A3WC: As long as there are doubts in the mind, the mortal staggers and falls.
As long as there are doubts in the mind till then man falls and staggers.
CWEW: The Guru removed my doubts, and I have obtained my place of rest. ||1||
When my Guru removed my doubts I obtained rest.
UNNE: Those quarrelsome enemies have been overcome, through the Guru.
Those quarrelsome adversaries they have left me through the Guru.
93LF: I have now escaped from them, and they have run away from me. ||1||Pause||
I have now escaped from them and they have escaped from me. Pause.
3DQH: He is concerned with 'mine and yours', and so he is held in bondage.
When man knows mine and yours since then he is held in bondage.
KEUN: When the Guru dispelled my ignorance, then the noose of death was cut away from my neck. ||2||
When the Guru dispelled my spiritual ignorance then was my noose cut.
102L: As long as he does not understand the Command of God's Will, he remains miserable.
As long as man understands not God's will so long he remains miserable.
D5ZG: Meeting with the Guru, he comes to recognize God's Will, and then, he becomes happy. ||3||
Meeting the Guru when he recognises Lord's will since then he becomes happy.
BLDB: I have no enemies and no adversaries; no one is wicked to me.
I have no enemy or an evil-wisher nor is nay one wicked towards me.
Z06T: That servant, who performs the Lord's service, O Nanak, is the slave of the Lord Master. ||4||17||119||
The servant who performs Guru's service O Nanak is the slave of the Lord.
SEKX: Peace, celestial poise and absolute bliss are obtained, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
Sing God's praises and you shall obtain peace poise and great happiness.
QKLQ: Bestowing His Name, the True Guru removes the evil omens. ||1||
Granting His Name the True Guru removes the evil influences.
MHXQ: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.
I am devoted to my Guru and am ever, ever a sacrifice to Him.
